Le géant des télécoms algérien Mobilis a: Algerian telecom giant Mobilis has forged a new ambitious partnership by signing a sponsorship contract with Mohamed Saeed Maallem, MMA fighter and light heavyweight world champion (BRAVE CF). This collaboration is part of the brand's strategy to support the national sports elite and promote the values of self-transcendence.
Dans un contexte où le sport algérien br: In a context where Algerian sport is shining on the international stage, Mobilis, a subsidiary of Algérie Télécom and historical leader of the telecommunications market in Algeria, formalized yesterday, Sunday, June 14, 2026, a strategic partnership with Mohamed Saeed Maallem. The latter, a mixed martial arts (MMA) specialist and holder of the light heavyweight world championship title within the prestigious BRAVE CF organization, thus becomes the brand's new ambassador.
Ce contrat s'inscrit dans la continuité: This contract is a continuation of Mobilis's commitments in favor of Algerian sport, having already supported renowned athletes such as boxer Mohamed Flissi and athlete Taoufik Makhloufi. For Mobilis, this partnership goes beyond a simple financial framework: it is about moral and logistical support for a champion who embodies the values of perseverance and excellence championed by the brand.
\"Nous sommes fiers de compter Mohamed S: "We are proud to count Mohamed Saeed among Mobilis's ambassadors. His exceptional journey and his commitment to Algeria make him a role model for young generations," declared a Mobilis official. This partnership adds to an already impressive list of sporting collaborations, reinforcing Mobilis's position as the leading sports partner in Algeria.
Avec ce nouveau contrat, Mobilis confirm: With this new contract, Mobilis confirms its desire to play a key role in the development of national sport, while capitalizing on the image of its ambassadors to strengthen its positioning in the competitive telecom market, facing rivals like Djezzy and Ooredoo. A strategy that could inspire other players in the sector to invest more in local sport.
Pour Mohamed Saeed Maallem, ce partenari: For Mohamed Saeed Maallem, this partnership represents further recognition of his talent and journey, after having already marked the history of Algerian MMA by winning the world title. A collaboration which, according to observers, could also open new opportunities for the development of combat sports in Algeria.
